Benchmark bootstrapped methods

nj_fun <- function(x) {
    dm <- dist.hamming(x)
    NJ(dm)
  }
unj_fun <- function(x) {
    dm <- dist.hamming(x)
    UNJ(dm)
}
mp_fun <- function(x) {
  mm_start <- NJ(dist.hamming(x))
  trees = pratchet(x, start = mm_start, minit = 10, maxit = 10000, all = TRUE, trace = 0, method = "fitch", rearrangements = "SPR", perturbation = "ratchet")
  if (inherits(trees, "multiPhylo")) {
    trees <- ape::consensus(trees, p = 1)
  }
  trees
}

library("patchwork")
pA = plot_metric_boxplots(results, "quartet_div", ylab = "quartet  divergence", title = "", methods = default_methods)
pB = plot_metric_boxplots(results_bs, "quartet_div", ylab = "quartet  divergence", title = "", methods = default_methods)
pC = plot_metric_boxplots(results, "cid", ylab = "igRF  dissimilarity", title = "", methods = default_methods)
pD = plot_metric_boxplots(results_bs, "cid", ylab = "igRF  dissimilarity", title = "", methods = default_methods)
pE = plot_accuracy_resolution(results)
pF = plot_accuracy_resolution(results_bs)
figure_6panel <- wrap_plots(
  pA, pB,
  pC, pD,
  pE, pF,
  ncol = 2,
  nrow = 3
) +
  plot_layout(ncol = 2, nrow = 3) +
  plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1, 1.5)) +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A") &
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 13),          # Scales all text (axes, legends, titles)
    axis.title = element_text(size = 13),    # Axis labels
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12),     # Tick labels
    plot.tag = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold") # A-F tags
  )
figure_6panel

ggsave("six_panel_figure.png", figure_6panel, width = 12, height = 12, dpi = 300)
